reviews.t: This stuff is great!! It's a little different from regular nail ...
reviews.x: This stuff is great!! It's a little different from regular nail polish though. It dries crazy fast (like, in 1 minute) and it dries to a very matte finish. I find that it covers well as long as you are generous with each coat. And, since it dries so quickly, you need to move fast when putting it on. :)
I just received these polishes and I must say I'm very happy with them. They all change colors. I made swatches and ran them under water to see if they would change and they did.💜💜💜love them
I'm wearing the blue and the color hasn't changed much

Love this set of fun to use colors. The colors DO change, some more noticeably than others. The polish dries within seconds so you need to apply quickly. Don't pay much attention to uneven strokes or streaks when applying because it blends itself together extremely well in a matte finish which becomes shiny upon application of a topcoat. The only downside to this polish is that regardless of the topcoat you layer it with, it will start to chip within a couple days.

reviews.t: LOVE! I got this for my daughter's 4th birthday
reviews.x: LOVE!  I got this for my daughter's 4th birthday, but who am I kidding, I got it for me!  First I did 1 coat of each color just to try it out.  It definitely needs 2-3 coats.  The 1 coat didn't last very long, so I've been doing 1-2 coats of clear also.  It DOES work when clear polish is over it.  I can see a change in every color.  Usually my feet are the cold color, and my fingers are the hot color.  LOVE this stuff!!!!!

reviews.t: but it really didn't make a difference to my daughter who loved the set anyway
reviews.x: Some colors didn't really change colors, but it really didn't make a difference to my daughter who loved the set anyway. The colors otherwise seem to be muted and there is a distinct odor once the nail polish is applied. Overall, a good gift for those who are fascinated with mood nail polish!

claims.text: Most reviewers say the color-change effect works, though some note certain colors change less noticeably than others.
The polish dries very fast to a matte finish, which reviewers say requires quick application and generous coats.
A common complaint is that the polish chips off quickly, sometimes within hours of application.
Several reviewers report that some colors did not change at all or looked different from the bottle/stickers.
Reviewers frequently describe the set as fun and a great gift, especially for kids.
